applicant.name: Dr. Lukas Berger
applicant.organisation: University of Applied Sciences, nursing programme

request.purpose: Our nursing students learn descriptive statistics on real-world patterns of chronic disease in a teaching module.
request.question: Overall, how many adults take a statin?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Statin = ATC code starting with C10AA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report: adults, adults with an active statin and the share in %, one decimal.
